title: Assetto Corsa Rally stages (early access, update 0.6, 2026-09-10)
keys: track is the name the game puts in its shared memory (static page 'track'), '<location> <short name>' in the game's language, here English, as PacenotePal builds it; the bridge sends it as ASCII (other characters as '_') cut to 31 characters. The game's trackSplineLength is not the published length (Cwmbiga - Afon Biga: 12077.95 m against 11.3 km), so lengths here are for the driver, not for matching.
notes: 46 selectable variants across 5 locations (Alsace, Wales, Monte Carlo, Greece = rally stages; Livigno = ice circuit) and 9 'special stages'. Lengths are the game's own per-variant Length (km, 0.1 km precision) from the DT_TracksVariants DataTable, extracted independently by two community tools (PacenotePal, dump committed 2026-06-29 with Greece; acr-live-timing, 2026-09-12) which agree on every value; press lists (Traxion, simracer.es, gamer.org) round the same figures to whole km, and official news gives Turini 18 km, Sisteron 13 km, Greece 22 km total (unique road), launch 33 km. length_m is that km value * 1000, NOT metre-precise. track = the string ACR puts in acpmf_static 'track' (wchar[33]) per PacenotePal's stage auto-detection (generate_stage_names.py): '<localized location name> <localized variant short name>', truncated to 32 chars. Values given are for the ENGLISH game language; the string changes with the UI language (e.g. 'Gales Cwmbiga', 'Griechenland Elatia - Zeli', 'Monte-Carlo ...'). It is NOT a stable id. Not independently verified from a live capture by me. config: acpmf_static trackConfiguration contents for ACR are undocumented in every tool found -> null. game_variant_id is the internal DataTable row id (also sent as wireId in ACR multiplayer UDP; note the 'Weles' typo for Wales rows); it is NOT exposed in shared memory as far as found. trackSplineLength is exposed but differs from the stage length (only one observed value: Hafren North Cwmbiga-Afon Biga 12077.95 m vs 11.3 km). No shakedown stages exist. Snow on Alsace/Wales (0.4) and Monte Carlo dynamic snow are weather conditions, not separate variants. Surface: from game SurfaceTypes; only Elatia full (85% gravel/15% tarmac) and Zeli cuts (65/35) are mixed. reverse_of pairs follow the game's Forward/Reverse row naming; some pairs differ slightly in length (e.g. Luttenbach 7.0 vs Foret de Munster 6.8).
